name: example-agency-marquee-reveal
title: Agency Marquee Reveal
description: Produce a self-contained agency landing hero that never stops moving: a synthetic ping-pong playhead (0→1→0, frame-rate-independent exponential damping) drives a velocity-reactive infinite marquee, a word-by-word igniting headline, and a sticky fold-style panel handoff — all playing on loop with zero scrolling or user input, from the first frame. One self-contained HTML file, 60fps, zero dependencies.
credits: Page structure, reveal-stagger contract, and fluid vw type scale inspired by darkroomengineering/satus (MIT); no source copied.
Velocity-reactive marquee feel modeled on darkroomengineering/lenis (MIT); reimplemented in vanilla JS.

useCase.query: Build a darkroom.engineering-grade agency landing hero as one perpetual loop: a self-driven synthetic playhead (ping-pong 0→1→0, exponentially damped) stands in for real scroll input, so a velocity-reactive infinite marquee, a word-by-word igniting hero statement, and a sticky Fold-style section handoff all run continuously from frame 0 with zero user interaction.
